text_block_list.text:
...Christmas is fast approaching this year 
as well.

Normally on that day, Loves Only You would 
stream an online Christmas party with her 
community members, but—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ta-da~♪ How is it?
choice_data_list: Oh...! This looks great on you too...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Really~!? That just leaves me even more 
spoiled for choice~♪

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Please, feel free to try on many more! 
Everything looks so lovely on you, 
customer, it really fires me up...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ You're so good with words♡ Well 
then, I'm totally leaning into that today♪

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
If you would like, why doesn't your 
companion try it on as well?

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"You can also check the visual balance of 
the two of you side by side, which might 
serve as good reference...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Trainer-kun, go change, go 
change! I wanna see lots of different 
looks on you!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Trainer-chan, go change, go 
change! I wanna see lots of different 
looks on you!

...As for why Loves Only You and I are 
here picking out formal wear today, we 
have to turn the clock back a bit—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—A ticket from the community members for a 
Japan Cup after-party?
choice_data_list: Yeah, they said the two of us should go
Yeah, they told the two of us to go.

text_block_list.text:
Sent out of the blue under the name "All 
Community Center Members," it was an 
invitation ticket to a Christmas dinner 
cruise.

Looking into it, the odds were apparently 
insane. Thinking about how much trouble 
the community members went through to get 
this makes my hands tremble...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
How wonderful...! This is going to be such 
a lovely wrap-up party!

Thoughtfully, an outfit rental voucher was 
enclosed along with the cruise tickets. It 
seems I'm meant to use it to pick out 
clothes for the day.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
......I see. Which means our Christmas 
date has already started!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We're heading out right now, Trainer-kun! 
We've gotta go find the most utterly luvvy 
outfit!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's head out right away, Trainer-chan! 
We gotta go find the most absolutely 
lovely outfit!

"—And that's the story of how Loves Only 
You and I ended up trying on so many 
different outfits together."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, look, look!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan, look, look!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
How's that? Pretty good at escorting, 
aren't I?
choice_data_list: Everything looks so good on you...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Geez. If anything, you praise everything 
too much, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Geez. If anything, you praise everything 
too much, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You two get along so very well, 
dear guests.

"...And so, the two of us had fun looking 
for outfits for that day—"
—And then, Christmas Day arrived.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, there's a buffet in addition to the 
dinner course!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Plus, they even have a live orchestra 
playing, so it's super luxurious and 
lovely♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-kun. We still have time 
before dinner, so why don't we look at the 
sea and—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-chan. We still have time 
before dinner, so why don't we look at the 
sea and—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer-kun? Is something the matter?
choice_data_list:
No, I was just thinking again how much it 
suits you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
......Trainer-chan? Is something the 
matter?
choice_data_list:
No, I was just thinking again how much it 
suits you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, why out of nowhere right now? I 
already showed it to you in the fitting 
room, didn't I?!"

Even so, those were genuine feelings that 
just slipped out after seeing Loves Only 
You standing in that dazzling space, but—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...You look super wonderful too, 
Trainer-kun♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...You're super wonderful too, 
Trainer-chan♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hehe♪ You're blushing, how lovely♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
......I'd like to look at the night view 
from the deck for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Would you mind showing me the way?

...And so, that night turned into an 
unforgettable Christmas spent together 
with Loves Only You—

And so, Loves Only You and I spent time 
gazing at the night cityscape and 
exploring the ship until dinner—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"—That meal was incredible...! The main 
meat dish was so good I might dream about 
it...!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely have to thank the 
commu-members. I'll share all my thoughts 
on stream...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Today was truly like a dream—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Aren't we going to join forces from here 
on to take on the world once more?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Before that... I think we should decide 
on this first."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Signature pose.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Just try imagining it for a second. Us, 
taking off into the wider world. Taking a 
glorious victory, swarmed by 
interviewers...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Cameras flashing left and right, asking 
me, 'A word for your Japanese fans on how 
you feel right now!' ...and stuff like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
If we strike a quick pose right there, 
it'd look super photogenic and so love, 
wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And so! Why don't we practice our victory 
poses for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat the details~♪ Hey, how about 
we use my usual stream greeting and make a 
heart shape together?

While somewhat overwhelmed by Loves Only 
You's pushiness, I couldn't just brush off 
her request—
choice_data_list: Okay, let's just give it a try for now...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks♪ Then, I'll say "Love me♡", 
and Trainer-kun, you follow up with "Love 
you♡".

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks♪ Then, I'll say "Love me♡", 
and Trainer-chan, you follow up with "Love 
you♡".

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And at the very end, we say "Loves Only 
You♡" and make a heart together! Well? 
Isn't it super lovely?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"It's totally fine! Once you try it, I'm 
sure you'll get used to it right away♪ So, 
let's get right to it♡"

Just now, the way she phrased it felt a 
little different from how she usually does 
on stream—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...It's your turn, Trainer-kun♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...It's your turn, Trainer-chan♪
